scope: Week 4c: integration of the week 4b research leads that were not admitted in week 4b. Part 1 covers the OpenAI and Anthropic control structures; part 2 the White House voluntary commitments, the Frontier AI Safety Commitments and the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice. All new records are seeds with machine-checked evidence; no editorial state changed.

integrator.model: One session of Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), the same model family that produced the week 4b leads. No subagents were used in week 4c. Its checks are not independent corroboration and are not human review.
integrator.method: The week 4b outcome files (research claims, two verifier reports and an adjudication per claim) were treated as leads. For every admitted claim the integrating session retrieved each cited source itself, read the passage in context, checked the quote, locator, dates, date precision, language and archive copy, and rewrote statements and qualifications where its reading differed. Leads were admitted, merged, narrowed or left out by the dispositions listed per part.
integrator.retrievalRule: Direct HTTP retrieval only, sequentially with pauses of 2.5 seconds between sources and 4 to 9 seconds between Internet Archive requests; archive captures were found through the CDX API and fetched in raw (id_) mode only where a publication-period expression was needed. The in-app browser was used only to inspect the built application, never to retrieve a source.
integrator.independence: The week 4b verifiers and adjudicators did not see this session’s checks, and this session read their reports. Agreement between them is one model’s agreement with itself.

quoteCheck.method: Every admitted quote was matched by the integrating session against its own direct fetch of the cited expression after removing invisible format characters, joining PDF line breaks after a dash or inside a hyphenated word, and collapsing whitespace; words, punctuation, quote marks and dashes must match. Quotes from scanned certificates without a reliable text layer were transcribed from the page images and compared visually; for the OpenAI Group PBC certificate the transcriptions were also compared with its OCR layer, where every difference was an OCR error. The text layer of Anthropic’s RSP v2.2 splits runs with direction marks and no spaces; two quotes from it were matched after also removing spaces, as their evidence notes say.
